summary: TSM rejected at Gate 4: $420.85 entry on a $25k account cannot fit even the small-scaled exception while using meaningful risk. Gate 0 (4/4 perspectives setup_direction=long), Gate 1 (can_open_new_position=true, phase=full), Gate 2 (combined_p_bull = (7/14 + 8/14)/2 = 0.5357; expected_return_per_share = 0.5357*(min(448.50,447.40)-420.85) - 0.4643*(420.85-max(414.50,411.50)) = 0.5357*26.55 - 0.4643*6.35 = +$11.27, POSITIVE), Gate 3 (qty=floor(250/6.35)=39 shares) all PASS. But Gate 3 notional 39*420.85=$16,413 (66% of account) blows through the 15% single_cap ($3,750). Small-scaled path: M=floor(5000/420.85)=11 shares -> notional $4,629 fits 20% extended cap, but risk_M = 11*6.35 = $69.85 is only 27.9% of the $250 risk budget, below the 40% floor ($100). Setup itself was strong (bulls 7/8 vs bears 7/6, daily ADX 43.37 with +DI 37.24 vs -DI 9.50, no earnings risk for 70 days) but capital math forecloses participation at this share price on a $25k account.
